title: bug: complete_step stores modifiedFiles unchecked and the plan sanitizer keeps only the first 50 on the next write, so paths 51+ silently leave the ASSERTED tier, while its siblings (submit_plan, the note cap) refuse past the same bound
description:
Found by hunt task-859eff80 (architect-74d9e1c7). It was held back only by the hunt's 4-row cap. The governor filed it at 16:30Z on 2026-11-03, after re-checking the citations at d5f36e82.

PROBLEM. complete_step accepts any number of modifiedFiles and stores them as given. The plan sanitizer then keeps only the first 50 on the next task write (state/validators.ts:790, `.slice(0, 50)`). The call succeeds, and no warning says paths were lost. Paths 51+ drop out of the ASSERTED attribution tier: the wrapper commits a task from its completed steps' modifiedFiles, and get_commit_scope's `asserted` no longer lists them. In shared mode those bytes stay unstaged. In every mode task.filesModified under-reports.

The sibling guards refuse instead:
- complete_step's own note cap, completeStep.ts:83-88, "refuse it up front instead, like every other capped text field";
- submit_plan, submitPlan.ts:395-402: "Step N has too many affected files (max 50)" and the same for newFiles.

EVIDENCE (HEAD ef5c7101, re-checked at d5f36e82). /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-859e/A/zzHuntAModifiedFiles.test.ts, output in zzHuntAModifiedFiles.output.txt:
- complete_step with 60 modifiedFiles returns success with no warning;
- the stored list has 50 entries;
- get_commit_scope's asserted is missing src/gen/file51.ts through file60.ts;
- the sibling control, submit_plan with 51 affectedFiles, is refused "too many affected files (max 50)".

FIX DIRECTION. Never lose a reported path silently. Two acceptable shapes; the planner picks one and says why:
(a) Refuse more than 50 modifiedFiles with INVALID_INPUT before any write, consistent with the siblings. The step stays IN_PROGRESS and no evidence is recorded. The message names the cap and the escape: report the first 50, then moe.declare_files the rest.
(b) Keep every reported path, with a bound of its own large enough for a regenerate step, e.g. record_commit's 500.
Either way, document it in docs/MCP_SERVER.md's complete_step section (around :475-490).

PLACEMENT (no dependsOn edge). task-314405bb edits MCP_SERVER.md's chat_decision section, and the docs-drift row filed alongside this one edits its set_task_status, archive_task and chat_send sections. Touch only the complete_step section.

VERIFICATION. vitest in the task worktree, never in the shared checkout: the new and changed completeStep test files, plus the existing completeStep and getCommitScope tests.
definitionOfDone: No reported path is lost silently. complete_step with more than 50 modifiedFiles is either refused with INVALID_INPUT before any write (the step stays IN_PROGRESS and the message names the cap and moe.declare_files), or stores every reported path so all of them appear in get_commit_scope's asserted. 50 or fewer behave exactly as today.
vitest covers 50 paths (all stored and asserted) and 60 paths (the chosen refusal or full retention), and the existing completeStep and getCommitScope tests still pass.
docs/MCP_SERVER.md's complete_step section states the bound and what happens past it.

implementationPlan.description:
One per-step file bound, shared by the tool and the sanitizer. This follows the MAX_STEP_NOTE_CHARS precedent at util/planSize.ts:31-32.

- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/planSize.ts: add `export const MAX_STEP_FILES = 50;` right after MAX_STEP_NOTE_CHARS. Doc comment: the most paths one plan step's affectedFiles, newFiles or modifiedFiles may hold; submit_plan refuses more per list, complete_step refuses more modifiedFiles, and the plan sanitizer bounds each list at the same value, so no tool accepts a path the next write would silently drop.
- packages/moe-daemon/src/state/validators.ts:
  - add MAX_STEP_FILES to the existing planSize import (:40);
  - in sanitizeImplementationPlan, replace `.slice(0, 50)` with `.slice(0, MAX_STEP_FILES)` on exactly the three per-step file-list lines: affectedFiles :789, newFiles :790, modifiedFiles :791.

Do NOT touch `plan.slice(0, 50)` at :775. That is the step-COUNT bound, a different number.

Zero behaviour change: the value stays 50. submitPlan.ts keeps its literal 50 (out of scope); test (5) pins it to the constant.
implementationPlan.note: Added MAX_STEP_FILES=50; the sanitizer's three per-step file slices use it; plan.slice(0, 50) (step count) untouched.

implementationPlan.description:
The refusal, in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/completeStep.ts. This is the task's error handling: a typed INVALID_INPUT thrown before any write.

- Import MAX_STEP_FILES beside MAX_STEP_NOTE_CHARS (:4).
- Directly after the note-cap refusal (:83-88), and so before the strict recordStepCompletion (:93-98) and before state.updateTask, add:
  `if (Array.isArray(params.modifiedFiles) && params.modifiedFiles.length > MAX_STEP_FILES) throw invalidInput('modifiedFiles', `too many paths (${params.modifiedFiles.length}). At most ${MAX_STEP_FILES} per step: report ${MAX_STEP_FILES} here and pass the rest to moe.declare_files.`);`
- Add a 3-line comment: the sanitizer keeps only the first MAX_STEP_FILES on the write, so the paths past it would silently leave the ASSERTED tier; refuse up front, like the note cap and submit_plan.

Count all entries, as submit_plan does. A non-array modifiedFiles keeps today's handling: the sanitizer drops it.

Change the modifiedFiles schema description to a template literal that ends: 'Omit nothing. At most ${MAX_STEP_FILES}: more is refused; pass the rest to moe.declare_files.'

Nothing else changes: 50 or fewer behave exactly as today, including the omitted-list warning. Reference: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/e3d41183-plan/planned.diff.
implementationPlan.note: Refusal added after the note cap, before recordStepCompletion/updateTask; schema description now a template literal.

implementationPlan.description:
Contract. Edit docs/MCP_SERVER.md, the `### moe.complete_step` section ONLY (:466 to just before `### moe.amend_plan_step`). Other open rows edit the chat_decision, set_task_status, archive_task and chat_send sections.

(a) In the Parameters block (:475), the modifiedFiles comment becomes: 'EVERY project-relative path this step created or modified, at most 50 — omitting it draws a `warning`'.
(b) A new Notes bullet directly after the ASSERTED-tier bullet (the one ending 'until someone declares it via `moe.declare_files`.'):
  '- At most 50 `modifiedFiles` per call, the plan sanitizer's per-step bound and `moe.submit_plan`'s `affectedFiles`/`newFiles` limit: more than 50 is refused with `INVALID_INPUT` before any write, so the step stays `IN_PROGRESS` and nothing is stored cut. Report 50 and pass the rest to `moe.declare_files` (up to 500 paths per call), whose paths are asserted too.'

The exact hunk is in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/e3d41183-plan/planned.diff.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: moe.complete_step refuses more than MAX_STEP_FILES (50) modifiedFiles with INVALID_INPUT before any write. The step stays IN_PROGRESS, and the message names the count, the bound and moe.declare_files, so no reported path is lost silently. 50 or fewer paths behave exactly as today. One exported constant, MAX_STEP_FILES, bounds the tool check and the plan sanitizer's three per-step file lists.
acceptanceCriteria: complete_step with 50 modifiedFiles stores all 50 on the COMPLETED step, and get_commit_scope's asserted contains every one.
complete_step with 60 modifiedFiles is refused INVALID_INPUT, the task JSON is byte-identical afterwards, and declare_files followed by complete_step with 50 leaves all 60 asserted.
invariants: No write happens before the refusal: no task write and no attempt step evidence.
sanitizeImplementationPlan's step-count bound (plan.slice(0, 50) at :775) is unchanged.

Existing task files hold at most 50 per list already (the sanitizer cut them), so nothing on disk changes.
submit_plan's literal 50 checks are unchanged and equal MAX_STEP_FILES.

moe.declare_files (MAX_DECLARED_PATHS_PER_CALL 500, ASSERTED and DECLARED tiers) is the documented escape for longer lists.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
I picked (a), refusal, over (b), keeping every path up to 500:
- (a) matches both siblings, submit_plan's per-list 50 and the complete_step note cap.
- (a) changes no state shape, and the escape (declare_files, 500 per call, ASSERTED and DECLARED) already exists.
- (b) would raise the sanitizer bound for one list. Every task JSON, and every get_context and QA payload that serves the plan, would then grow with steps of hundreds of paths. It also leaves modifiedFiles out of step with affectedFiles and newFiles.
I also rejected unifying submitPlan.ts's literals in this row: that would add a sixth file. Test (5) pins it to the constant instead.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- The same 50 appears twice in sanitizeImplementationPlan with different meanings: the step count (:775) and the per-step file lists (:789-791). Only the latter becomes MAX_STEP_FILES.
- complete_task derives filesModified from the steps' modifiedFiles ?? affectedFiles (completeTask.ts:236-241) and takes no list of its own, so the step list is the only lossy point.
- The architect's dry run (planned diff, test, c0 and c1) is in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/e3d41183-plan/.
planningNotes.risks:
- Replacing `plan.slice(0, 50)` by mistake would tie the step count to the file bound; review (c) checks for it.
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md is touched by several open rows: edit only the complete_step section.
- The full daemon suite can flake on a loaded host: re-run once before treating a failure in an unrelated file as real, and quote both runs.
- Type every tracked edit with Edit/Write. Copying the scratch reference files is a shell write with no TOOL witness.
